leadHtml:
ARCADE V0.27.0 COMPLETE

@fzlt/core/arcade

The shell every page arcade game repeats, so a game is only its rules and its art. One engine per run over the host page (@fzlt/core/board-page: its words are terrain, its buttons are targets), a fixed overlay with a canvas and a scoreboard in the Board UI kit (title, sound, pause, fold and exit keys, readouts, an optional meter, action keys, a comms toast), keys and pointer (@fzlt/core/input), the touch pad on coarse pointers (@fzlt/core/pad), sound from the event ring (@fzlt/core/sound), sparks and stacking score popups, factory health painted into the buttons, and a controller a hub drives: start, pause, resume, stop, destroy, getSnapshot. While a run is live, a click on the page fires instead of following a link; the scoreboard, fields and [data-virus-ignore] / [data-fizlet-ignore] keep their clicks. Recall (Escape, the exit key, stop) destroys the engine, so every letter and button comes back exactly; a run that ends keeps the scoreboard with the result until Recall. The game supplies create(ctx): its own systems on ctx.engine, reading ctx.ctl (written in the read phase) and drawing in render. The scoreboard and controls are a HUD preset, chosen per game with hud (BOARD-UI.md §19): arcadeHud() is today's card and the default (no hud renders it byte for byte); skirmishHud({...}) is Battlefield Blitz's top bar with a clock, rank and armor bar, a feed, a banner, aim toggles and counted keys, and its flow (countdown, pause / surrender, result) on @fzlt/core/match: then match owns the phase, the shell asks it to pause, resume or end and follows it (HudView.ask, HudRun.go). Each preset is its own export, so a game ships only the one it names.

IN SHORT
const game = arcade({ id: "null-invaders", title: "Null Invaders", color: "#06c4ff",
  hint: "Mouse / WASD · Space fires", css: KIT_CSS, fire: true,
  readouts: [["Score", "team"], ["Wave"]], colors: ["#06c4ff"],
  cues: { fire: "fire" }, create: (ctx) => myRules(ctx) }, { root: "main" });
game.start(); // Escape: Recall

The skirmish preset (Battlefield Blitz): hud: skirmishHud({ readouts: [{ label: "Kills", tone: "team" }, { label: "Time", kind: "clock" }, { label: "Armor", kind: "bar", low: 0.3 }] }). hud(out) fills the readouts in order, then any count slots.

export declare function skirmishHud(o: SkirmishOptions): ArcadeHud;

SkirmishOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for the skirmish HUD preset: its readouts, header and nav keys, feed, banner, overlays, result, aim toggles and key counts.

export interface SkirmishOptions {
    /** Readouts, in the order `hud(out)` fills them. */
    readouts: SkirmishReadout[];
    /** Header keys, in order (default full screen, sound, pause, exit; `fold` hides the title and the
     *  text keys). Full screen shows only where the page may use it. */
    header?: ("fullscreen" | "sound" | "pause" | "fold" | "exit")[];
    /** Text keys after the actions, as on the card (default none): `next` (Next gate, G), `restart`,
     *  `auto` (Auto fire: needs `fire`). */
    nav?: ("next" | "restart" | "auto")[];
    /** A feed of the last `rows` (default 4) events of type `on`, newest first. */
    feed?: {
        rows?: number;
        on: string;
        line: (a: number, b: number) => string;
    };
    /** A centred banner (title, sub) on each event of type `on`. */
    banner?: {
        on: string;
        text: (a: number, b: number) => readonly [string, string?];
    };
    /** Overlays (default all four; @fzlt/core/match runs the flow either way). `countdown` holds the start
     *  for 3, 2, 1 on the flow's clock; without `pause` or `result` that phase shows no overlay; without
     *  `surrender` the pause card has no SURRENDER key. */
    overlays?: ("pause" | "surrender" | "countdown" | "result")[];
    /** The result card: `stats()` keys to list, and the one whose best is kept on this device. */
    result?: {
        stats: string[];
        best?: string;
    };
    /** Aim toggles: the intents `aim-auto` and `aim-lock` (`ctx.input.down("aim-lock")`). */
    aim?: ("auto" | "lock")[];
    /** Counted keys: action id → the `hud(out)` slot of its count, a badge on its keys. */
    counts?: Record<string, number>;
}

SkirmishReadout interface COMPLETE

One readout on the skirmish bar: its label, how the value shows and its tone.

export interface SkirmishReadout {
    label: string;
    /** How the value shows: `num` (default) 12 · `clock` 3:05 from seconds · `rank` #2 · `pct` 75%
     *  from 0..1 · `bar` a meter from 0..1 (armor, health). */
    kind?: "num" | "clock" | "rank" | "pct" | "bar";
    tone?: "team" | "enemy";
    /** A bar: class `low` at or under this (0..1). */
    low?: number;
}

MODE, PX, PY, PON, KX, KY, FIRE, VW, VH, CALM, TARGET_HP const COMPLETE

Controls and view, written once per frame in the read phase (a step reads them): mode (0 keys or stick, 1 pointer), pointer x, y and on, move x, y (-1..1), fire, viewport width and height, and reduced motion (1/0). The game writes TARGET_HP: the full health of a target, for its paint.

export declare const MODE = 0, PX = 1, PY = 2, PON = 3, KX = 4, KY = 5, FIRE = 6, VW = 7, VH = 8, CALM = 9, TARGET_HP = 10;

ArcadeAction interface COMPLETE

One action key: the intent it drives, its keyboard code and its scoreboard text.

export interface ArcadeAction {
    /** The controls intent: `ctx.input.hit(id)` in a step. */
    id: string;
    /** KeyboardEvent.code, e.g. "KeyB". */
    key: string;
    /** Scoreboard key text, e.g. "B · Cover". */
    label: string;
}

ArcadeStatus type COMPLETE

Where a run is: idle, running, paused, won, game over or destroyed.

export type ArcadeStatus = "idle" | "running" | "paused" | "won" | "gameover" | "destroyed";

ArcadeOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for arcade(): the board and its selectors, theme, seed, reduced motion, sound and controls, and the onState / onEvent / onError hooks.

export interface ArcadeOptions<S> {
    /** The board: a selector or an element (default document.body). */
    root?: string | Element;
    textSelector?: string;
    targetSelector?: string;
    excludeSelector?: string;
    /** "system" (default) follows the visitor's colour scheme. */
    theme?: "dark" | "light" | "system";
    seed?: number;
    reducedMotion?: boolean;
    /** Start with sound on (default true; it waits for a gesture to unlock). */
    sound?: boolean;
    /** "keyboard": the mouse never steers. */
    controls?: "mouse" | "keyboard";
    onState?: (state: ArcadeSnapshot<S>) => void;
    onEvent?: (event: {
        type: string;
        game: string;
        [key: string]: unknown;
    }) => void;
    onError?: (error: unknown) => void;
}

ArcadeSnapshot type COMPLETE

What the controller reports about a run: its status, time and frame cost, plus the game's own state.

export type ArcadeSnapshot<S> = Partial<S> & {
    id: string;
    status: ArcadeStatus;
    elapsed: number;
    frameMs: number;
    maxFrameMs: number;
    notice: string;
    /** Letters indexed, on screen and spent, and the range reads the last measurement made. */
    board?: {
        indexed: number;
        visible: number;
        spent: number;
        measurements: number;
    };
    /** Sparks alive (at most 100). */
    particles?: number;
};

ArcadeController interface COMPLETE

The controller arcade() returns: start, pause, resume, stop and destroy a run, and read its snapshot.

export interface ArcadeController<S> {
    start(): ArcadeSnapshot<S>;
    pause(): void;
    resume(): void;
    stop(): void;
    destroy(): void;
    getSnapshot(): ArcadeSnapshot<S>;
}

ArcadeContext interface COMPLETE

What create gets: the run's engine and board, the controls, and the shell's presentation.

export interface ArcadeContext {
    engine: Engine;
    board: BoardPage;
    input: Controls;
    /** MODE … TARGET_HP (see the constants). */
    ctl: Float64Array;
    reduced(): boolean;
    /** A popup at (x, y): `+value` when `text` is null (stacked with nearby ones), else the text.
     *  Tone 0 score, 1 accent (upgrade), 2 hurt. Call it from render (react). */
    popup(x: number, y: number, value: number, text: string | null, tone?: 0 | 1 | 2): void;
    /** n sparks from (x, y) in colour `c` (an index into `colors`); none under reduced motion. */
    spark(x: number, y: number, n: number, c: number): void;
    /** A line in the comms toast. */
    say(text: string, ms?: number): void;
    /** onEvent for the hub (a plain object: call it from render, not a step). */
    emit(type: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    /** In-page art: a shadow root in an overlay inside `el` (an absolutely positioned host that
     *  follows the page's layout, scrolling and transforms natively). A static `el` becomes
     *  relative. Through the ledger: Recall removes it and puts the style back. Call from create
     *  or reset (it reads computed style), never from a step. Null for replaced elements. */
    attach(el: Element): ShadowRoot | null;
}

ArcadeGame interface COMPLETE

One run of your game, as the shell drives it: reset, draw, the HUD and meter, page scroll, reactions to events, stats, and whether the run is over.

export interface ArcadeGame<S> {
    /** A fresh run (the viewport is in ctl[VW], ctl[VH]). */
    reset(): void;
    /** 0 playing, 1 lost, 2 won: read every render; the run ends the frame it turns non-zero. */
    over(): number;
    /** The page scrolled by (dx, dy): move page-space things (read phase). */
    scroll?(dx: number, dy: number): void;
    /** Each event on the ring this frame (render): popups, sparks, the toast, onEvent. */
    react?(ev: FizEvent): void;
    /** Draw on the canvas (render), after the target beacons, before sparks and popups. */
    draw(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, dt: number): void;
    /** The readout values, in `readouts` order, then the meter's change key (render, change-only). */
    hud(out: Float64Array): void;
    /** The meter's left text, right text and fill 0..1, when its change key moved. */
    meter?(): readonly [string, string, number];
    /** The snapshot's game fields (not a hot path). */
    stats(): S;
}

ArcadeDef interface COMPLETE

Your game for arcade(): its id, title, accent, hint, CSS, actions, readouts, sound cues and create(), which makes a run.

export interface ArcadeDef<S> {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    /** The game's accent (hex): title, meter, popups, target paint at full health. */
    color: string;
    hint: string;
    touchHint?: string;
    /** The Board UI kit CSS text (the game bakes in the sections it uses). */
    css: string;
    /** Hold Space / the pointer to fire; a Fire key on the touch pad and an Auto fire key. */
    fire?: boolean;
    actions?: ArcadeAction[];
    /** Touch move control (default "stick"; "dpad" for grid games). */
    pad?: "stick" | "dpad";
    /** Keys (or the stick) only: the mouse never steers. */
    keyboard?: boolean;
    /** The card's readouts: label, tone, how the value shows, and whether it hides when the board is
     *  folded. A preset with its own readouts (skirmish) leaves this out. */
    readouts?: [label: string, tone?: "team" | "enemy" | undefined, fmt?: ((v: number) => string) | undefined, fold?: boolean | undefined][];
    meter?: {
        label: string;
    };
    /** Spark colours, by index. */
    colors: string[];
    /** Event type → sound cue. */
    cues: Record<string, Cue>;
    /** Paint targets with their health (default true). */
    paint?: boolean;
    /** The scoreboard and controls: a HUD preset (default `arcadeHud()`, today's card). */
    hud?: ArcadeHud;
    create(ctx: ArcadeContext): ArcadeGame<S>;
}

ArcadeHud interface COMPLETE

A HUD preset: its CSS (after the game's kit CSS) and a mount, once per run.

export interface ArcadeHud {
    css: string;
    /** Extra controls intents the HUD drives (e.g. aim toggles): intent → key codes. */
    keys?: Record<string, string[]>;
    mount(run: HudRun): HudView;
}

HudRun interface COMPLETE

What the shell gives a HUD when a run starts.

export interface HudRun {
    /** The kit root (`.bui`), the canvas already in it. */
    ui: HTMLElement;
    def: ArcadeDef<any>;
    engine: Engine;
    input: Controls;
    /** A coarse pointer: build the touch pad. */
    coarse: boolean;
    /** The game, once `create` returned: read it in `write`, never in `mount`. */
    game: ArcadeGame<any>;
    /** Sound (a scoreboard key flips `on`). */
    sfx: {
        on: boolean;
    };
    /** Aborts at Recall: the overlay's life. */
    signal: AbortSignal;
    status(): ArcadeStatus;
    /** Moves the run, for a HUD that owns its flow (`ask`), once its phase changed: pause, resume,
     *  the end (won, lost), a rematch (restart) or Recall (exit). */
    go(to: ArcadeFlow | "restart" | "exit"): void;
}

ArcadeFlow type COMPLETE

A change in a run's flow the HUD is told about: paused, resumed, won or lost.

export type ArcadeFlow = "pause" | "resume" | "won" | "lost";

HudView interface COMPLETE

A mounted HUD. Keys are button[data-a] (sound, pause, exit, restart, gate, auto, fold, or the HUD's own) and button[data-act] (an action): the shell runs them, then calls key.

export interface HudView {
    /** The comms toast. */
    msg: HTMLElement;
    /** Every render and once at start: change-only writes, nothing allocated in the steady state. */
    write(): void;
    /** The status changed: the pause key, overlays. */
    sync(): void;
    /** A scoreboard key ran: repaint its face (`auto`: auto fire is on). */
    key(a: string, b: HTMLElement, auto: boolean): void;
    /** At start, in place of starting the engine: a countdown that calls `go` when it is done. */
    begin?(go: () => void): void;
    /** Before the engine goes at the end of a run (its ledger takes back what went through it). */
    hold?(): void;
    /** The run ended and the page is back: show the result. */
    end(won: boolean, notice: string, stats: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    /** The HUD owns the phase (skirmish: `@fzlt/core/match`): the shell's pause, resume and end are asked of
     *  it, and it answers with `HudRun.go` (one owner; the shell keeps the keys and delegates). */
    ask?(to: ArcadeFlow): void;
}

ArcadeHudOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for the default HUD: which header keys and which nav keys, in order.

export interface ArcadeHudOptions {
    /** Header keys, in order (default all four). */
    header?: ("sound" | "pause" | "fold" | "exit")[];
    /** The nav row after the action keys (default all three; `auto` needs `fire`). */
    nav?: ("next" | "restart" | "auto")[];
}

arcadeHud function COMPLETE

The arcade preset, the default: one card with the title, sound / pause / fold / exit keys, the readouts, one meter, the nav row (actions, Next gate, Restart, Auto fire) and the toast; phones get the pad and the card folded at the top. arcadeHud() renders exactly what leaving hud out renders. Values: hud(out) fills the readouts in order, then the meter's change key.
